non_blocking.what: The execute exemption is keyed on the row id alone, so a hand-over from another plugin that names its row glm-hourness/execute passes it. Design 3.2 also keys only on the row, so this matches the design; ownership elsewhere is keyed on (plugin, row).

problems only grows. After a faulty hand-over is withdrawn or replaced by a good one the row health stays degraded until the row reloads, and 'told' in registry.ts keeps the same message from being re-reported if the fault returns. The set of distinct messages is bounded only by what rows hand over, so the health text can get long. No information is lost.

A waiting entry's reason names the undeclared event by id, not by its human title (design 3.2 wants the title). The coder recorded this as Interpretation 3; the title is unknown while nobody declares the event, so the page step needs a remembered title or other wording.

loops.peak-start and loops.peak-end are contributed unconditionally; design 5.2 says rows 13 and 14 appear only when the pricing service is there. Both stay greyed because channel.peak-changed has no declarer, and the deferral to channel.ts is documented. Revisit when channel.ts lands.
